name: Operit AI
description: Android agent app that links cloud or on-device models to system functions, a terminal, the browser and files to perform real tasks.
whatItDoes: Works as an on-phone assistant that can operate the device, run commands, browse and manage project workspaces across multi-turn tasks. It targets Android power users who want an agent running directly on their handset.
howItWorks: The app wraps a chat interface around a tool layer that exposes Android capabilities, a built-in terminal environment and installable tool packages. Models can be remote or local. It is installed from an APK and needs Android 8.0 or newer on an ARM64 device.

requirements.name: Model access
requirements.description: Cloud provider key or a local model
